entities.summary: The Church of San Antolín de Toques is a church in Toques, Galicia, Spain. Founded in the 10th century, it's one of the most complex buildings of the Middle Ages in Galicia, as it preserves elements and pieces from very different periods. It was declared a Bien de Interés Cultural in 1994.
